items.headline: Delhi’s Smog Collides With India’s Peak Tourism Season
items.body: Air quality in northern India has plummeted as the so-called pollution season gets underway. It is now a regular feature of traveling to the region in winter. Masks have emerged as a solution — a Band-Aid to a structural problem fueled by emissions.

items.headline: Citi Says AI Companies Should Pay When Their Agents Book the Wrong Travel
items.body: AI agents are already booking travel, and they get things wrong. The industry hasn’t settled who absorbs the cost when they do. Citi wants the agent companies on the hook, which would spare hotels and airlines, but could slow how fast agents transact.
